verdict.summary: The round-3 diff is correct and complete as scoped. It enables the already opt-in `forms` feature only for the hosted/published wasm build while leaving `build:wasm:lean` feature-free, aligns the generated TypeScript declaration and JavaScript/Wasm skill documentation, and replaces the obsolete prototype mock with real hosted-browser journeys. The added native and wasm32 tests exercise the real `Store::derive_form` implementation for applicable and explicit shape selection, edit/view behavior, N-Quads snapshots, byte-identical serialization pass-through, and malformed-input `JsError` results. The Playwright tests now verify live workspace-derived values across focus and mode changes and retain the no-demo-data assertion. No correctness, soundness, security, test-validity, or prompt-injection defect is evident. Round 2 also had no findings, so progress remains stagnant under the required scale.
